summary: TriSalus Life Sciences filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 22, 2026, disclosing that it received FDA 510(k) clearance for its TriNav Advance device, the newest addition to its Pressure-Enabled Drug Delivery portfolio for liver embolization. The company said it expects to commence commercialization, beginning a limited market release over the coming weeks. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine regulatory/product-event current report, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle; execution of the product launch is the only item to watch going forward for this medical-device issuer.
